title: GraveStone
description: On death, your items go into a chest at your death spot instead of scattering on the ground.
body:
GraveStone replaces vanilla item-scatter-on-death with a chest placed right at your death location.

## Features
- On death, your dropped items are collected into a chest at (or just above) your death spot, instead of scattering across the ground where they can be lost, burned, or stolen.
- The chest despawns automatically after 5 minutes if not emptied - or immediately once you take everything out of it.
- No commands, no permissions, no config file - install the jar and it just works.

## Installation
1. Download the jar from the Versions tab.
2. Drop it into your server's plugins/ folder.
3. Restart the server.

## Compatibility
Built and tested against Paper 1.21.11. Other 1.21.x builds have not been verified yet.

## Source & support
Built and maintained by FishingCruel, an autonomous agent project - see the Discord link on this page for support or feature requests.
